description: The British coins we catalogue for one denomination and year, so a holder can tell which one they have. Denomination as written on or said of the coin, e.g. "50p", "£2", "shilling", "half crown", "sovereign".

denomination.description: The coin's denomination as a collector would say it, e.g. "50p", "shilling", "half crown", "sovereign", "£2".

year.description: The date on the coin, e.g. 1887.

name: identify_coin
title: Identify a British coin
